caseData.headline: Likely: bad loans are being reported as good ones

findings.plain: bad loans are being reported as good ones
money from lenders or linked companies is arriving dressed up as customer payments

signals.explanation: Servicer-system pull: 3 of 60 sampled 'eligible' loans are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
Loans reported current but with no payment for two months were pulled from the servicer system: 7 of 8 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
Loans the tape shows going from 30-59 days late to current were pulled from the servicer system: 4 of 5 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
8 loans flagged 'deferred' with no disclosed deferment programme
7.8% of loans reported current had no payment arrive (27 of 346)
$31,752 (2.1% of inflows) came from 'Hannah Chen', who is not a known customer or obligor
Not enrolled in Setpoint PledgeCheck: whether this collateral is also pledged at other lenders can't be verified

steps.title: Ask who the listed payer is paying for
steps.draft:
DRAFT LETTER — Ask who the listed payer is paying for
To: Borrower B0004, attention: Chief Financial Officer
Re: Facility monitoring — request for information (B0004)

As part of our routine monitoring of the facility, we have identified items we need to reconcile:
  - $31,752 (2.1% of inflows) came from 'Hannah Chen', who is not a known customer or obligor [ref S3-B0004-NON_OBLIGOR_PAYER-9e5ad1af]

Please provide for each listed payer, the customer it paid on behalf of and the arrangement that lets it pay (for example a parent company, an insurer or a factor) by 2026-10-11.

This letter requests information to reconcile our records. It does not allege wrongdoing by any party.

[Credit officer], Wells Fargo

steps.title: Trace the flows back to their origin

steps.title: Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
steps.draft:
INTERNAL ACTION MEMO — Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
Case: B0004 · Finding: bad loans are being reported as good ones (medium confidence)
Action: Increase the servicer-system sample to at least 200 loans and compare status field by field.
Based on:
  - Servicer-system pull: 2 of 60 sampled 'eligible' loans are actually 60+ days late or no longer active [ref S2-B0004-SOURCE_MISMATCH-faca5bff]
  - 3.5% of loans reported current had no payment arrive (35 of 1005) [ref S2-B0004-CURRENT_WITHOUT_PAYMENT-2e056945]

Due: 2026-09-14 · Requires approval before it is carried out.
[DRAFT — synthetic demonstration data]
